title: Reality Fracture
description: Space itself is cracked like shattered glass, each fragment reflecting a different version of the world that never was. Light bends at impossible angles along the fracture lines, and stepping too close sends vertigo crashing through your skull. Between the cracks, null particles drift like silent snow.

choices.label: Harvest the fracture edges
choices.description: Carefully peel thin membranes of compressed space from along the fracture lines.

outcomes.text: The membranes peel away like translucent sheets of compressed reality. They fold into impossibly small shapes for easy carrying.
Most membranes come free cleanly, but one fracture snaps shut on your fingers. The compressed space leaves deep cuts that bleed in strange colors.
The fracture web destabilizes as you pull. Shards of broken reality rain down, cutting through armor and flesh alike.

choices.label: Peer through for treasure
choices.description: Look through the fractured reflections for objects caught between dimensions.

outcomes.text: Between two cracks, a coin purse floats in frozen suspension. You carefully extract it — still heavy with gold from a world that no longer exists.
You spot null fragments drifting in the spaces between — solidified pieces of the void visible only through the fractures. You snag several.
You peer too deeply and vertigo seizes you. The fractures show a thousand versions of your own death. Your party drags you back, retching and shaking.

choices.label: Back away
choices.description: The geometry here is wrong in ways that hurt to comprehend.

outcomes.text: You avert your eyes from the fractures and navigate by sound alone until the geometry straightens itself. Some sights cannot be unseen.
